subject: VPC onboarding & network gating — sprint plan and checklist
messages:
From: Simon Elliot <simon.elliot@brightmed.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@brightmed.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VPC onboarding & network gating — sprint plan and checklist

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We want to move forward with a private (VPC) deployment for our inference tier. Before we kick a formal kickoff, my infra lead (Priya) and I want a concrete list of gating checks we can run in parallel with our procurement timeline.

High level asks from our side:
- What exact ACLs and subnets do you expect in our account?
- Do you require dedicated NAT / egress IPs for telemetry/metrics?
- Token/key exchange and KMS workflow — what permissions and service accounts are needed?
- Any firewall rules for model download or runtime health checks?

We have a short window in the next two weeks to validate the network and hand off to your onboarding team. Can you put together a sprint-style checklist (owner, ETA, blocker) so we can plan workstreams?

Appreciate it —
Simon
Simon Elliot
Head of Platform Engineering, BrightMed Health
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Elliot <simon.elliot@brightmed.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@brightmed.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC onboarding & network gating — sprint plan and checklist

Simon —

Great to hear you want to move forward. Attached is a compact sprint checklist we use for gated private deployments (redwood-vpc-prereqs.pdf) plus an activation workbook (activation-checklist.xlsx) you can drop into your project tracker. Summary here so you can triage quickly: 

1) Network topology and IPs
   - Required: 2 subnets (control-plane, runtime) per AZ; routable to Redwoods' peering IPs.
   - Optional: dedicated egress IPs if you require fixed outbound IPs for allowlisting.
   - Owner: BrightMed networking; ETA: 3 business days to provision.

2) Firewall and outbound rules
   - Allow outbound to s3.redwood.ai (model downloads) + metrics.redwood.ai on ports 443/8443.
   - Healthcheck endpoints: /health (443) to allow runtime probes.
   - Owner: BrightMed firewall team; ETA: 1 day to test.

3) Service accounts & KMS
   - Create a service account with roles: IAM Service Account User, KMS CryptoKey Decrypter for key ring which will host encryption keys.
   - We will provide a short-runbook for key rotation on our side.
   - Owner: BrightMed security; ETA: 2 business days.

4) Peering & route-acceptance
   - Exchange peering configs; we prefer AWS PrivateLink or VPC Peering depending on your topology.
   - Exchange test CIDRs ahead of peering.

5) Certificate and DNS plan
   - Provide FQDNs for internal endpoints and TLS cert requirements.

6) Validation steps (smoke tests)
   - Model fetch sanity check (download + checksum).
   - Runtime inference smoke (small prompt perf).
   - Metrics ingestion verification.

I've flagged two blockers in the PDF that typically delay activation (missing egress/allowlist and KMS role gaps). Attaching a simple network diagram export you sent (bm-network-topology.png) and added inline comments in the activation workbook.

Next steps: if you can confirm owners and a target kickoff date, Karthik (solutions) and Marissa (onboarding) will schedule a short 60-minute alignment call to run the sprint backlog.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-vpc-prereqs.pdf (pdf), activation-checklist.xlsx (xlsx), bm-network-topology.png (png)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Elliot <simon.elliot@brightmed.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@brightmed.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC onboarding & network gating — sprint plan and checklist

Alex / Marissa / Simon — quick internal notes and propose owners for the sprint: 

- Network provisioning: BrightMed (Simon) + Marissa (onboarding) for verification. I can run the peering/preflight tests once routing is in place.
- KMS and keys: Marissa to coordinate with our security ops; Simon to create the key ring and give our service account decrypter permission.
- Egress: If BrightMed needs static egress IPs, we will provide the allowlist range; otherwise we route through Redwood-managed NAT and document differences (cost delta).

Proposed timeline: kickoff 2027-05-24, gating complete by 2027-05-28, go/no-go on 2027-05-31. If this works for you I will create a short action tracker and drop a calendar invite.

On the tests side I added two quick notes to the activation workbook: checksum verification for model blobs and a token-liveness test to reduce flaky failures in early runs.

-Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: VPC onboarding & network gating — sprint plan and checklist

Simon / Priya —

Thanks — timeline looks good and we appreciate the quick turnaround. Final confirmation:

- Kickoff scheduled: Mon 2027-05-24 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite sent).
- Deliverables before kickoff: BrightMed to create service account + key ring, provision the two subnets and provide route table exports, and apply outbound allowlist for 443 to the domains in the PDF.
- On our side: onboarding will validate peering and run the model fetch smoke test within 24 hours of peering.

I also attached a DocuSign link for the standard Dedicated onboarding SOW (small one-page addendum) so procurement can sign in parallel. If procurement needs an amended SLT/uptime clause please loop in the legal contact on your side and we can accelerate the review.

See you Monday.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
